Day was from the date of first dose of CPX-POM administration. Dates are displayed as DDMMMYYYY, -- represents an unknown date
component.
Prior = any medication whose end date is before the date of first dose.
Conc. = concomitant = any medication that started before the date of first dose and stopped on (or is ongoing after) the date of
first dose OR any medication whose start date is either the same as (or after) the date of first dose.
